---
title: "Artificial Intelligence 2019-1 (Systems Engineering)"
---

This course introduces the fundamental concepts of artificial intelligence, including classical search methods, genetic algorithms, fuzzy logic, machine learning, classification techniques, regression models, gradient descent optimization, and neural networks.  
ITM – Institución Universitaria @2019
